author: Corridor Crew
description:
The movie Michael (2026) tells the story of the early life of Michael Jackson, focusing on his life beyond the music during his journey from discovery to success. As an important element in his life, his chimpanzee Bubbles was featured in the movie, brought to life through an entirely CGI character made by the masters at ILM.

Today, the real Bubbles is 43 years old and lives at the Center for Great Apes sanctuary in Florida.

Did the CGI-ness of his young character take you out of the movie experience?
title: Michael Jackson's Favorite Pet
